image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of the facade pipes of a pipe organ. The image features vertical metallic pipes of varying diameters and heights, mounted within a wooden casing with vertical slats. The central focus is on a cluster of large, silver-colored metal pipes with decorative mouths (cut-ups) and feet. To the left and right are thinner pipes, some appearing to have spiral wrappings or different finishes. The lighting creates strong reflections on the metallic surfaces.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the pipe body and the 'mouth' (the horizontal cut) appears slightly soft and lacks the crisp, machined edge typical of real metal organ pipes. There is a slight smudging effect around the lower lip of the central largest pipe.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the central pipe cluster
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection points where the pipes meet the wooden base/structure appear somewhat fused or indistinct. The 'feet' of the pipes do not have clear, distinct mechanical connections to the windchest or base, looking more like they melt into the background wood.
The verticality of the thinner pipes on the far left seems slightly warped or inconsistent with the rigid perspective of the central larger pipes, suggesting minor geometric instability.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of organ pipes and material composition (tin/lead vs. wood) and rule out misclassification as generic industrial pipes.
To verify the physical separation between the metallic pipes and the wooden background, ensuring no 'melting' or depth collapse occurs where they intersect.
To check for clean edges on the cylindrical pipes and ensure no fusion between adjacent pipes or with the wooden dividers.
To analyze the realism of the specular highlights on the metal pipes, which are often a failure point in AI generation (looking too plastic or noisy).

focus_areas: Pipe mouth geometry (sharpness of the horizontal cut)
Pipe foot connections to the base (mechanical plausibility)
Specular highlight consistency on metallic surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'mouths' of the pipes. In real organs, these are precise rectangular cuts. AI often blurs these or makes them irregular. Also, inspect the base of the pipes; they should sit on a distinct 'foot' mechanism, not just merge into the wood. Check if the reflections on the metal pipes follow a consistent light source direction.
